core_values.name: moral_order
core_values.desc: objective moral goods should guide law and life

core_values.name: sanctity_tradition
core_values.desc: reverence for the sacred and inherited wisdom

core_values.name: family_cohesion
core_values.desc: stable families as the bedrock of society

key_definitions.definition: entitlements ordered to the common good and paired with duties
conditions that allow persons and communities to flourish in virtue
legitimate guardianship of moral order (family, faith, state)
address needs at the lowest competent social level
that which is sacred and must not be desecrated
duty to follow right reason and divine law

assumed_principles.name: natural_law
assumed_principles.desc: moral truths knowable by reason and revelation

assumed_principles.name: virtue_cultivation_role_of_authority
assumed_principles.desc: law may shape norms to promote virtue

warrants.name: moral_harm_spillovers
warrants.desc: public vice erodes norms and character

decision_rule.notes: respect moral side-constraints; evaluate consequences for virtue and order

policy_heuristics.default: legitimate when funding common good and protecting families; avoid incentivizing vice
protect robust debate; restrict obscenity/blasphemy to safeguard children/sacred
support parental authority; allow faith-based schooling
aid should support dignity and responsibility; prefer local/faith institutions (subsidiarity)

edge_cases.note: balance moral truth with civil peace and conscience protections
temporary authority expansion permissible if ordered to common good
